q: TCP ka 3-way handshake kaun se order mein hota hai?
explain: Client SYN bhejta hai, server SYN-ACK deta hai, phir client ACK bhejta hai, isi se connection ready hota hai.

q: In mein se kaun sa protocol aam taur par UDP par chalta hai?
explain: DNS normal queries ke liye UDP port 53 use karta hai, kyunki query chhoti hoti hai aur speed zaroori hai.

q: Flow control aur congestion control mein kya farak hai?
options: Flow control receiver ko bachata hai (rwnd), congestion control network ko (cwnd)
Flow control network ko bachata hai, congestion control receiver ko
Dono sirf UDP mein hote hain
explain: Flow control slow receiver ko overflow se bachata hai (rwnd); congestion control network overload se bachata hai (cwnd).

q: UDP header ka size kitna hota hai?
explain: UDP header sirf 8 bytes ka hai: source port, destination port, length, checksum. Isi liye UDP light aur fast hai.

q: TCP slow start mein ssthresh = 16 hai aur cwnd = 20 par timeout hota hai. Timeout ke turant baad ssthresh aur cwnd kya honge?
explain: Timeout par ssthresh = cwnd/2 = 20/2 = 10 ho jaata hai aur cwnd = 1 MSS par reset hota hai, phir slow start shuru.
